name: cAMP responsive element modulator

function.text: CREM encodes cAMP-responsive element modulator. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in signal transduction and cAMP/PKA signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Hyalinizing clear cell carcinoma of salivary gland; Intracranial mesenchymal tumor, FET::CREB fusion-positive. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
